newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks plunge amid blue-chip selling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks plunge amid blue-chip selling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks plunged on Thursday as lack of institutional buying prompted small investors to offload expensive blue chips and dealers said the index could edge lower on Friday.
"Weak investor have lost patience as major investors have kept away from the market," dealer Ali Raza Mooney of KAB Securities said. More selling was likely by small investors.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 16.94 points, or 1.08 percent, to end at 1,556.14. Losers led gainers 216 to 59. Turnover rose to 49 million shares from 31 million on Wednesday.

Adamjee Insurance fell 3.50 to 104 rupees, Dewan Salman Fibre 0.45 to 38 and D.G. Khan Cement 0.60 to 14.65. PTCL fell 0.35 to 28.75, Hub Power Co 0.55 to 36.85 and Shell Pakistan 5.0 to 240. ICI Pakistan fell 0.35 to 23.90 and FFC Jordan Fertilizer 0.20 to 17.10.
